decisions: All 48 labels independently re-derived with the existing Track C deriveQuestion implementation; no historical case was subtracted from gold.
24 different finding/event families, 24 connected groups, 12 narrow and 12 broad groups, six questions per area/class.
All eight first-page judge question IDs selected before retrieval, one per area/class.
Old dev/holdout positives and recorded retrieval/Track N candidates, calibration cases, scope questions, prompts and fixtures are excluded.
Task 10d full channel/candidate records cover the earlier Track C retrieval configuration at the same generation; raw corpus construction metadata alone is not treated as model exposure.

The explicit multi-state ORs in some broad predicates are necessary to retain at least 21 genuinely unexposed positives. They are complete predicates and visible in question wording; no gold filters enter execution.
Canonical finding dictionary labels are used; deprecated narrative description suffixes C/F are not interpreted as gold.

Shared aviation words such as fuel, oil and flight planning do not mean shared predicates: exact families and case memberships differ. No same-predicate rewording with only a changed state/year was admitted.
Generic/unknown finding families were rejected as ambiguous. Aircraft systems includes system components and fluids, not flight-performance measurements.
The field guard is deliberately conservative: 50 US states plus DC; territories, unknown/offshore codes and ambiguous place-only readings are unsupported.
All positive field values and additional OR members are backed by distinct real coded seed records. Controls intentionally have no positive target-field constraint.
Exact question duplicates were rejected during construction. Both raw and state/year-masked comparisons to prior questions used token Jaccard 0.70 and trigram Jaccard 0.80, with zero flags.

Within-set paraphrases and common wording families are declared, not counted as additional independent case groups. Field Wilson intervals describe the registered sampling distribution, not arbitrary public traffic.
